openings.claim: Repair surname storage with a current exception locator linked to reservation identity and checked whenever books move; cart books need not be shelved to accelerate pickup.
openings.discriminator: Accurate addresses should reduce second searches at matched load; continued peak delays with little searching favor clerk congestion. Match arrival volume and book size before interpreting cart speed.
openings.probe: Compare comparable pickups before/during locator updates; record arrival, service start, retrieval, completion, location accuracy, second searches and update work. Stop if preparation plus corrections counted as preparation exceeds ten clerk-minutes.
openings.uncertainty: Fit covers the capped probe; identity-check capability, sustained maintenance and improved outcomes are unconfirmed. Household mismatches may not explain second searches.

openings.probe: Trial across the evening concentration; record address errors, capacity-forced moves, preparation, corrections and pickup duration. Stop at ten preparation minutes; incomplete setup fails feasibility.

decision: Compare both using existing paper, pencils and timing sheet. Only the evening clerk verifies identity and hands off; names/contact details stay behind desk; use two shelves and one cart only. Require 95% of available pickups within two minutes and zero wrong-reader handoffs. Synthetic samples establish neither effects nor target attainment.
